استئست (form X)
# اُسْتُئِسْتُ (ustuʔistu) /us.tu.ʔis.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَآسَ (istaʔāsa)
# اُسْتُئِسْتَ (ustuʔista) /us.tu.ʔis.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَآسَ (istaʔāsa)
# اُسْتُئِسْتِ (ustuʔisti) /us.tu.ʔis.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَآسَ (istaʔāsa)
